name: The Links of Stillwater
tagline: Your new local clubhouse on the east side.
intro: Four GolfZon TwoVision NX bays in the east metro, opened February 2026. A joint entertainment venue connected to a bowling alley: the golf is ours, the burgers are Stillwater Bowl next door, and you can have both without moving the car.

highlights.title: Top-of-the-line simulator technology
highlights.body: The same GolfZon TwoVision NX bays as Lakeville, on the same tour spec. Four of them, on this side of the river.

highlights.title: Leagues and contests you'll love
highlights.body: Floating and fixed day leagues, paired with weekly contests. Stillwater has never run a league season before, so this first one is being drawn up from scratch rather than copied over — join the list and you will see it the day it is finished.

highlights.title: Full bar and menu
highlights.body: In partnership with Stillwater Bowl: burgers, bites and a full selection of drinks, without leaving the building.

hoursNote: Summer hours. If there are no pre-booked bay times, we reserve the right to open late or close early — so if you are making a special trip, book the bay rather than chancing it.
amenities: Food & drink via Stillwater Bowl & Lounge
needsFromClient: Winter hours - the published schedule ends 30 Sept 2026
